exact_statement: For a Boolean f with v=Var(f)>0, freeze any admissible conditioned-forest representation and globally feasible positive lambda and finite distinct-run sets W_A covering its nonempty spectral support. Put c=Lambda+log2 Z, t_A=sum_(r in W_A)2^(-B_lambda(A;r)), R_*=v c+sum_(A nonempty)p_A(-log2 t_A), Kref=3+2log2 3+log2(6e), and U(A)=2^(-c-Kref|A|)t_A. Then U is a subprobability, min_P(E B-H(P))=-log2 t_A, and h2(v)+Kref I+R_*=H(f)+v D(P^+||U). Consequently universal R_*<=K I implies FEI with C=2+Kref+K. Independently, B<=K I implies good-coordinate B_i<=K alpha_i and FEI(K+2/ln2); full-signed L<=K I implies FEI(K+3/ln2), while FEI(C) implies B<=C I and L<=C I. No reverse admission into the forest reference family is asserted.

exact_statement: For every n>=2, set N=2^n,d=n+1,g_n(x)=1-2*1_(x=(1,...,1)) and F_n(x,z)=g_n(x_1z,...,x_nz). Then B(F_n)=L(F_n)=0, I(F_n)=2d/N, and the single-gate conditioned forest for -F_n, ordered support 1,...,d, M=1,lambda=1,pi=1/N and the unique partition run on each nonempty A has complete residual R=(6/5)sum_(A nonempty)p_A log2[(product_(j=1..|A|) i_j)/|A|!] <=(12/5)I(F_n). Here i_1<...<i_|A| enumerate A. Its root rarity cancels against v(Lambda+log2 Z) exactly.
